The [[Axe of the Kinslayer]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[axe]] obtained from the [[Chest of Burrows]], which spawns after defeating [[Frostmaw the Kinslayer]] in [[Frostmaw's Burrows]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 6-28 (Requires 9 [[Axe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30
